Bill for National Commission for Men introduced in Rajya Sabha

A private member's bill proposing the establishment of a National Commission for Men was introduced in the Rajya Sabha. The bill aims to protect men's rights, address their grievances, and review policies affecting their well-being, citing the need to recognize men as potential victims. The introduction follows the Siya-Ketan case.
